## SmartStockAZY — UI polish

- Grouped market, scanner, decision and portfolio metrics into compact strips.
- Combined the research chart and price levels into one panel.
- Grouped detailed evidence and simplified news previews.
- Consolidated settings and kept optional AI collapsed when disabled.

- Added a dedicated News workspace with automatic market headlines, quick topics, ticker search and expandable event analysis.

## Download

**Windows 10/11 (64-bit):** Download **SmartStockAZY.exe** from Assets. No Python, paid API or GitHub account required. The executable is unsigned.

Already using SmartStockAZY? Open **Settings → Application updates** to check, download and install. Your local SQLite data remains separate from the executable.

[Setup guide](https://github.com/3AYZE/SmartStockAZY/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md) · [Project home](https://github.com/3AYZE/SmartStockAZY) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/3AYZE/SmartStockAZY/issues/new)
